# Blue Noise Textures

Pre-computed blue noise threshold textures for high-quality dithering.

## Source

These textures are from [Calinou/free-blue-noise-textures](https://github.com/Calinou/free-blue-noise-textures).

## License

CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain)

## Files

- `blue-noise-64.png` - 64×64 HDR luminance blue noise
- `blue-noise-128.png` - 128×128 HDR luminance blue noise

## Usage

Load the PNG and use pixel values as threshold values for ordered dithering.
Blue noise produces visually pleasing dithering with minimal low-frequency artifacts.
